free_tier_limits: Free plan: private projects up to 50k LOC, max 5 org members, unlimited public projects (main branch only). Separate free OSS plan: unlimited public repos, no private projects.
paid_plans: Team (from ~$34/mo, 100k–1.9M private LOC, unlimited members) and Enterprise (custom/annual, unlimited LOC ideal from 5M LOC, SSO/SCIM, portfolios, etc.). Priced by private LOC analyzed, not API calls. See sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing/sonarcloud/
